findings.desc: CHK-002 and CHK-003 verificationEvidence is not reproducible enough for a formal staging audit. The recorded commands use placeholders like "CHK-001 readiness transcript" and opaque "claude -p ..." labels without the exact prompt text, input anchor payload, or any explicit Codex command/transcript reference, so an auditor cannot replay the skipped-positive-path decision or the claimed same-anchor dual-host review. Persist the exact shell commands/prompts/inputs and the explicit receipt-ref absence check in verificationEvidence.

The story claims this worktree isolated eight unrelated dirty files from Orchestrate main, but no persisted baseline names those files or records the source git-status snapshot. After main becomes clean, that isolation claim is no longer independently auditable. Record the exact dirty-file list or the captured `git -C <main-root> status --short` output alongside the story evidence.

Current main is not an ancestor of story/B-51f6, and `git diff main..HEAD` still contains 12 non-story files outside `.koala/story/actives/B-51f6/**`. That violates the requirement that this branch stay isolated to story metadata and any strictly necessary allowlist updates. Merge/rebase current main into the story branch and re-check that only B-51f6 metadata remains in the final diff.
